# Pragiso Soft Technologies

> Pragiso Soft Technologies (PragisoTech) is an IT company, software development consultancy, and SaaS product engineering firm based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About the Company
- **Organization Name:** Pragiso Soft Technologies (also known as PragisoTech)
- **Website:** https://www.pragisotech.in
- **Headquarters:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Primary Contact:** contact@pragisotech.in | +91-90809-61649
- **Core Specializations:** Custom Web Application Development (React, TypeScript, TanStack), Mobile App & PWA Development (Flutter, React, iOS, Android), UI/UX Interface Design, SEO & Digital Marketing, Cloud Systems, Field Operations SaaS Software, and CCTV & Security Surveillance (Authorised Secure Plus CCTV Dealer).

## Flagship Product: Pragiso CRM
- **Product Name:** Pragiso CRM (Enterprise Field Service Management Software)
- **Product URL:** https://www.pragisotech.in/products
- **Target Audience:** Field service contractors, equipment manufacturers, facilities management, electrical, HVAC, and telecom service enterprises.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Real-time technician GPS tracking and live control-room map dispatch.
  - Geofenced mobile punch-in/punch-out attendance for field engineers.
  - Screen-off Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline job queue and routing.
  - Digital job signatures, spare parts consumption logs, and inspection checklists.
  - Instant branded PDF service call slips with customer signature and before/after repair photo verification.
  - 7-day risk-free live demo with zero upfront obligation.

## Secondary Service: CCTV & Security Surveillance
- **Status:** Pragiso Soft Technologies is an authorised dealer of Secure Plus CCTV cameras in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
- **Service Page:** https://www.pragisotech.in/secure-plus-cctv
- **Capabilities:** Supply and installation of Secure Plus and Umaiya Security System HD dome, bullet, and PTZ cameras; DVR/NVR multi-channel configuration; mobile remote viewing setup for Android and iOS; maintenance and troubleshooting; plus wholesale stock and hardware supply for local CCTV sub-dealers and installers.
- **Target Segments:** Residential homes, apartments, villas, retail shops, corporate offices, warehouses, industrial sites, and B2B security sub-dealers in Coimbatore.
